report.status_line: Critical water shortage following trailer tank rupture and static tank depletion; loft tank half-empty.

concerns.title: Water Crisis: Trailer Tank Ruptured and Static Tank Empty
concerns.detail: The commander reported on 2015-01-16 that the trailer tank has ruptured, the static tank is empty (engineering reported less than 10 cm), and the loft tank is half-empty, preventing refilling of the loft tank. The crew expects to run out of water tomorrow and is entering a critical water contingency plan. Water projections based on the crew's ~360 L estimate from 2015-01-13 (not actual measurements): if usage matches the FMARS reference rate (12.12 L/person-day), projected remaining water is about 105.5 L (about 1.2 days left, running out on 2015-01-17), requiring a daily budget of about 2.2 L per person-day to reach mission end on 2015-01-23. If usage matches the NASA potable minimum (2.5 L/person-day), projected remaining water is 307.5 L (about 17.6 days left, running out on 2015-02-02), requiring a daily budget of about 6.3 L per person-day.

concerns.title: Hot Water System Failure
concerns.detail: Engineering reported that hot water has still not been attained and requested additional mitigation strategies.

crew_actions: Initiate critical water contingency plan and strict conservation protocols immediately.
Monitor and record loft tank water level draw-down closely.
Inspect trailer tank and static tank connections for any salvageable water or containment options.
Continue hot water troubleshooting per habitat operating procedures while awaiting Mission Support mitigation advice.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Authorize emergency water resupply to the habitat.
decisions_for_earth.why: The trailer tank ruptured, the static tank is empty, and the crew projects running out of water tomorrow without immediate replenishment.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Approve or deny the EVA requested for January 17, 2015.
decisions_for_earth.why: The commander submitted an EVA request for tomorrow, which requires Earth approval and may need rescheduling due to the water emergency.

report.message_to_earth: CRITICAL: Hab water supply is critically low following a trailer tank rupture and depletion of the static tank. On 2015-01-16, the commander reported the trailer tank ruptured, the static tank is empty, and the loft tank is half-empty. Based on a ~360 L estimate from 2015-01-13, projected remaining water at typical rates is about 105.5 L with about 1.2 days remaining. The crew is enacting a critical water contingency plan with rationing and monitoring the loft tank. Propane is nominal at 39%, diesel is less than 75%, but hot water remains unavailable. Immediate Earth authorization for an emergency water resupply is requested by tomorrow morning. Next update will be sent tomorrow with the morning report.
